benchmarks.label: LN
benchmarks.definition: All to lower terminal mean need; split on ties

definitions.frameworkBehavior: At rho_0.001: ES_pp == 0 gives exact equal division; otherwise AL_pp == 0 gives favor lower terminal mean need; otherwise EO_pp < ES_pp gives resembles equal mean surplus (relative to ES only, not nearest); otherwise show all rounded-nearest benchmarks. Prefix Stop if initial_ask == 0, Ask if initial_ask == 1, otherwise the initial-question percentage. Rules do not use condition IDs or predicted outcomes.
definitions.distances: Mean absolute allocation-share difference at matched terminal beliefs and remaining budget, in percentage points; ten trials then nine equal-weight schedules
definitions.minimum: All minima after Python fixed-point formatting to two decimal places
definitions.realizedUtility: realized_u: sum of recipient utilities evaluated at target-specific true needs and saved allocation/budget; no personal-time subtraction; not posterior expected utility
definitions.initialSearch: 100 * initial_ask: percentage of endpoints with an initial question
definitions.trueNeedOutcome: Final share of the strictly higher true-need recipient; exclude exact true-need category ties
definitions.trueNeedPredictors: True need in tutoring units divided by initial tutoring budget, not terminal budget
definitions.gap_slope: Intercept OLS of higher-true-need share on (higher minus lower true need) / initial budget within each ten-trial schedule
definitions.lower_need_partial: Coefficient on lower true need / initial budget in intercept OLS controlling higher true need / initial budget within each schedule
definitions.undefined: Reject undefined plotted fits; never drop a schedule or condition-price point
definitions.provenance: Fixed-target model outcomes; plotting consistency does not authenticate sources or establish original historical trajectories, Monte Carlo precision, or human inference
